subject: Commit stabilization — action plan & data matrix
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit stabilization — action plan & data matrix

Team —

Short version: finance needs accurate commit-level fields by EOD Friday (6/14) so we can lock Q3 ARR. We saw a number of high-dollar deals with missing/ambiguous amounts, product/SKU lines, or stale next-steps/probabilities in the CRM export. That creates churn in the forecast and forces manual adjustments.

Please do the following for every open deal you own in the "Commit" stage (close date in Q3):
- Confirm Amount: match contract value/quote. No estimated ranges — enter a single canonical amount.
- Normalize Product/SKU: if there are multiple line items, list primary SKU and add a short note in "Deal Notes" if needed. We provided a template CSV if you want to paste.
- Next Step & Owner: single next-step and an owner with a target date. Avoid vague statuses like "Working".
- Probability: use the 4-tier guidance in the sheet (60/80/95/100). If a special case, flag in the comments and ping finance.

Resources:
- Commit data matrix (please copy into your folder and update only your rows): https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-commit-matrix
- Export we pulled for speed: commit-data-matrix-template.csv (attached) and deal-list-export-20280610.csv (attached)

Important process notes:
- If you change Amount by >10% or move a deal out of "Commit," add a brief reason in the Deal Notes.
- Large deals (> $250k ARR) require a quick comment thread (AE + SDR + CS) and a flag to me so we can consider a forecast adjustment.
- I will run a spot-check on Monday morning and escalate any open items to managers.

Deliverable: update your rows in the Google sheet + confirm via reply to this thread by EOD 6/14.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick answers:
- Ben: enter Year 1 ARR into the Amount field for forecast purposes. Put total contract value in Deal Notes and note the allocation methodology.
- Lauren: perfect — thanks for the specifics and the PDF. If NIM-4499 looks like a multi-line expansion, flag it as an "Expansion" type in the sheet (so we don't double-count).

I'll run a two-person spot-check on Monday 6/15 AM (Finance + RevOps) and escalate any deals with missing amounts/SKU or missing next steps. If any deal > $250k changes after Monday, we'll treat it as a forecast motion and adjust executive forecast slides.

One small process change: going forward, when a deal moves into Commit, the AE should run the checklist (there's a checklist tab on the sheet) and set a probability band. If you want, I'll spin a 15-minute optional office hour tomorrow at 3pm PST to help folks through the sheet.

Thanks and appreciate the quick turnaround —
Jordan
Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
